title: Student Planner
tagline: A planner PWA for students: tasks, courses and reminders in one place.
highlights: Push reminders from a scheduled Cloudflare Worker (FCM)
description: Started in 2021 as a Materialize + Firebase web app and still going. The current version ships as a PWA and a desktop app, with its own [documentation site](https://github.com/Jerit3787/planner-docs).
